
# @hexa-ui/icons
The **@hexa-ui/icons** project is responsible for converting SVGs defined by the design team into React components.

These components can be easily used in various projects and applications, providing a consistent and scalable way of displaying icons.

By automating the conversion process, this project ensures that the icons are always up-to-date and easily accessible for use in different contexts.

This project also includes a library of pre-built icons, making it easy for developers to find and use the icons they need without having to create them from scratch.

## Stack
- [SVGR](https://react-svgr.com/)

## Installing

Install @hexa-ui/icons using yarn, npm or pnpm.

```bash
yarn add @hexa-ui/icons
```

If your project is already using version 1 of @hexa-ui/icons and you cannot replace it with version 2, you will need to create an alias to install the package.

To create an alias for the @hexa-ui/icons package, you can use the yarn command bellow. This command installs the lastest version of the package as `@hexa-ui/icons2`, allowing you to install both versions side-by-side.

```bash
yarn add @hexa-ui/icons2@npm:@hexa-ui/icons@latest
```


## Usage

```typescript
import { Beer } from '@hexa-ui/icons';

function Component() {
  return <Beer />;
};
```
